description: Reverse-lookup a person profile by any of their social URLs/handles. Pass linkedin, twitter, or github (full URL like https://www.linkedin.com/in/foo, OR just the handle 'foo'). Multiple params allowed: first match wins. Returns the full person profile + which platform matched. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

linkedin.description: LinkedIn URL or handle (e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/in/foo or just "foo")

twitter.description: Twitter/X URL or handle (e.g. https://x.com/foo or "@foo")

name: get_person_by_social
title: Look up person by social
